memory_candidates.content: Cross-repository relay tasks (BimodalLogic -> ModelChecker) follow the task-701 shape: ready-to-file replacement text inside this repository's summary, per amended entry/row; citations by fully qualified Lean declaration name (never file:line, per the paired repo's own convention); dangling-citation checks on both sides at filing time; the paired repository is never written. Triage each relay point as confirm (already their position), correct (their text is stale), or introduce (new information that changes their logic).

Wire-format extension rule derived from HOA's header discipline: a consumer that does not understand semantics-bearing content must error, never reinterpret. For the bimodal certificate wire, both re-checkers (Lean decodeOptLassos and Python raw.get('lassos', [])) read an absent lassos key as [] and then reject structurally, so a sliced-certificate envelope must OMIT lassos entirely; a document carrying both lassos and slices would be silently checked as a lasso family by an unaware checker.

Literature-index relevance notes can mis-cite definition numbers; verify against chunk text before relaying. In hodkinson_wolter_zakharyaschev_2000, the periodic state function with bounded period is Theorem 24 / Lemmas 21, 23 (section 5), not Definition 20 (which defines 'realizes psi1 U psi2 in m steps'); sharp(phi) counts distinct realizable state candidates, not slice width. 'Ultimately periodic' does not occur in biere_heljanko_junttila_latvala_schuppan_2006, which says 'lasso-shaped', beta gamma^omega, '(k,l)-loop'.
